component.name: AimRust
component.summary: Fast, modern aim trainer built with Rust and Bevy

description.p: AimRust is a high-performance FPS aim trainer built from the ground up in Rust using Bevy Engine. It features responsive mechanics, customizable crosshairs, sensitivity scaling, ADS, and various aim training scenarios.

ul.li: Multiple aim-training task modes (Gridshot, Flick, Spidershot, Tracking, and more)
In-depth session results, accuracy stats, and score tracking
Customizable crosshair styles, colors, and camera FOV settings
ADS mechanics, recoil simulation, and chamber mode
Optional portable mode via portable.ini to keep settings self-contained
